subject: How to display SVG graphic with "tooltips" in shiny mainpanel

messages.author: 92851a35f2512ad7
messages.subject: How to display SVG graphic with "tooltips" in shiny mainpanel
parts:
I use a shiny app to generate a graph in SVG format in the mainpanel. Example of app is here: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/crtahlin/shinyapp_tests/

A snippet of the code that renders the mainpanel:

 mainPanel(
         tabsetPanel(
         tabPanel("Graph", h3(textOutput("message")), imageOutput("dataPlot", height="100%")),
         tabPanel("Data", tableOutput("dataTable")),
         tabPanel("Parameters", tableOutput("parametersTable")),
         tabPanel(title="Errors", verbatimTextOutput("errors")),
         tabPanel(title="Debug",h3("Client Session Parameters"), verbatimTextOutput("debug"))
       )
    )

The SVG renders, but if I move the mouse pointer over the dots on the plot, no "tooltips" are displayed. The SVG itself contains this information - if I save the plot via the right mouse button and ope it in a browser, I get the tooltips on mouse-over. 

I think a general solution for displaying SVG inside webpages is described here:
http://www.w3schools.com/svg/svg_inhtml.asp
     
Questions: 
- Is there a way to display SVG with tooltips in shiny?
- Is shiny meant to display "tooltips" in SVG (is this considered a bug)?

Thanks,
Crt
